title: Owed Service-Recovery Courtesy Amount (Hospital Account (Encounter Billing))
content:
**Ceiling.** On a Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account, the courtesy ceiling is the smaller of the patient class's service-recovery courtesy maximum (from the courtesy limits) and the account's patient balance, and never below 0.00: an account whose patient balance is 0.00 or less (a zero or credit balance) is owed no courtesy.

**Standard courtesy.** The standard courtesy is 0.2 of the service-recovery courtesy maximum (20 percent of it), rounded half-up to the cent, and the courtesy is the standard courtesy, never more than the courtesy ceiling.

**Combination.** Allowances are combined with that figure this way: an allowance that sets the courtesy's starting amount replaces the standard courtesy as that starting amount, every allowance stated in dollars is then added to it, and the courtesy is the smaller of that total and the courtesy ceiling.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

| Courtesy maximum | Patient balance | Ceiling | Standard courtesy | Courtesy |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 50.00 | 900.00 | 50.00 | 10.00 | 10.00 |
| 50.00 | 6.00 | 6.00 | 10.00 | 6.00 |
| 100.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 20.00 | none owed |
| 100.00 | credit of 3.00 | 0.00 | 20.00 | none owed |

*Combination (hypothetical).* With a starting amount set at 30.00 and 15.00 in dollar allowances on a ceiling of 40.00, the total of 45.00 is held to 40.00.
